content: Self-hosted LLM rankers: feeds.fun (LLM tags + user rules tag->score, sort by score), betternews (0-1 score vs learned profile, hides <0.35), rosso (written interest profile), PersonalRSS (explainable evidence per card, High/Maybe/Filtered views, neutral 0.5 cold start, strong feedback 2x weight). TT-RSS: summed filter scores, up/down score icon, click to adjust, <0 excluded from Fresh, <-500 auto-read, >1000 auto-star.
